items.a: We are open {{hoursSummary}}. Timings can change on festival days, so please call ahead on a holiday.
On the first floor of Perreddy Complex at Pathur Road Cross, Tadepalle, near Reliance Digital — {{address}}.
Booking online or by phone means you are seen at a fixed time with little waiting. If you walk in, we will fit you in as soon as we can.

items.q: How much will my treatment cost?
items.a: It depends on what the examination shows. Dr. Ramakanth explains the plan and its cost before any treatment begins, so there are no surprises.

items.q: Is the first visit just a consultation?
items.a: Usually, yes: a careful examination, a chat about what we found and your options. Simple treatment can sometimes be done the same day if you wish.
Yes. We keep early visits short and friendly, and give parents practical advice on brushing and diet.

items.q: I'm nervous about the dentist. What can I do?
items.a: Tell us when you book or when you arrive. We go at your pace, explain each step and you can ask us to stop at any time.

items.q: What should I bring to my appointment?
items.a: A list of the medicines you take, any previous dental X-rays or reports, and your phone for the booking confirmation.

items.q: How do I cancel or move my appointment?
items.a: Sign in to your patient account to reschedule or cancel, or call the clinic. Letting us know early frees the slot for someone in pain.

items.q: What should I do in a dental emergency?
items.a: Call the clinic during opening hours. For heavy bleeding, swelling that affects breathing or swallowing, or a facial injury, go to the nearest hospital emergency department straight away.
